evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies JSON-RPC parameter parsing and dispatch in src/rpc/mining.cpp and src/rpc/client.cpp.
rationale: Expands the generateblock RPC to support custom multi-destination coinbase payouts and optional mempool transaction inclusion. Reviewer feedback confirms this fills a gap for developers testing and simulating mining pool payouts such as Ocean or Braidpool.
